title: Performance Marketing Manager
shortDescription: Build, optimize, and scale high-ROAS paid search and paid social campaign architectures across Meta, Google, and TikTok.
aboutRole: As a Performance Marketing Manager at MyAdSphere, you will take full ownership of client acquisition funnels. You will work directly with creative strategists and media buyers to deploy million-dollar ad budgets into high-ROI growth engines.
responsibilities: Design and execute multi-channel paid acquisition campaigns on Meta Ads, Google Search, Performance Max, and TikTok.
Conduct weekly creative testing iterations, analyzing visual hooks, ad copy variations, and post-click conversion rates.
Manage client ad budgets, bid strategies, and server-side tracking (CAPI) setups to maximize return on ad spend.
Build real-time executive dashboards in Looker Studio tracking CPA, ROAS, and net revenue metrics.
requirements: 3+ years of hands-on experience managing performance marketing ad spend above $50k/month.
Deep expertise with Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads (Search & Shopping), and Google Tag Manager.
Strong analytical mindset with proficiency in GA4 conversion modeling and attribution frameworks.
Exceptional communication skills and client-facing strategic presentation capabilities.
niceToHave: Experience with e-commerce platforms (Shopify Plus) and B2B SaaS CRM tools (HubSpot).
Familiarity with server-side GTM containers and first-party data tracking tools.

title: Lead SEO Specialist
shortDescription: Engineers technical site architecture, keyword topical authority clusters, and generative search (GEO) visibility for global client brands.
aboutRole: We are seeking a Lead SEO Specialist to engineer high-ranking organic search engines for enterprise clients. You will combine technical crawl budget auditing with strategic editorial content clusters that systematically capture first-page search demand.
responsibilities: Perform comprehensive technical SEO audits, resolving Core Web Vitals bottlenecks, schema markup, and indexing issues.
Architect keyword demand maps and topical authority content clusters for high-intent transactional search terms.
Lead ethical digital PR link acquisition campaigns to build domain authority across high-tier publications.
Optimize site data structures for AI search engines including Google Search Generative Experience (SGE) and ChatGPT.
requirements: 4+ years of proven SEO experience with a portfolio of rank growth case studies.
Proficiency in Ahrefs, SEMrush, Screaming Frog, Google Search Console, and schema data structures.
Solid understanding of JavaScript SEO, technical rendering, and site speed acceleration.
Analytical ability to translate organic traffic metrics into business revenue outcomes.
niceToHave: Experience with Webflow, WordPress, and Next.js SEO optimization.
Familiarity with Python for SEO automation or data scraping.

title: Creative Video & Motion Director
shortDescription: Direct, shoot, and edit high-converting short-form video ads, motion graphics, and brand assets for social platforms.
aboutRole: As Creative Video Director, you will lead the visual storytelling aspect of MyAdSphere. You will script, direct, and produce short-form video ads (Reels, TikTok, Shorts) and motion design assets built to stop user scrolling and drive immediate engagement.
responsibilities: Script and direct high-impact short-form video ad creative tailored for Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube.
Edit fast-paced, hook-driven video ad assets using Adobe Premiere, After Effects, and DaVinci Resolve.
Collaborate with performance marketers to analyze creative performance metrics and iterate winning video angles.
Manage on-set video production, lighting setups, actor direction, and product photography.
requirements: 3+ years of professional video editing and motion graphics experience with a strong portfolio.
Expertise in Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, and modern social video editing trends.
Understanding of psychological visual hooks and performance creative ad structures.
Strong aesthetic judgment and keen eye for typography, color grading, and pacing.
niceToHave: Experience directing UGC creators and influencer content shoots.
Basic 3D animation skills in Blender or Cinema 4D.

title: B2B Lead Generation Strategist
shortDescription: Design automated multi-channel B2B outreach funnels, interactive qualification quizzes, and CRM lead nurture pipelines.
aboutRole: Our B2B Lead Generation Strategist builds end-to-end customer acquisition systems for enterprise SaaS and service clients. You will combine LinkedIn Ads precision targeting with automated lead qualification engines to deliver sales-ready prospects.
responsibilities: Build account-based marketing (ABM) campaigns targeting specific company sizes, executive titles, and tech stacks.
Design interactive calculator and quiz funnels that pre-qualify prospects before scheduling sales demos.
Configure automated email and SMS nurture sequences to maximize appointment booking show-up rates.
Integrate lead capture systems seamlessly with HubSpot, Salesforce, and GoHighLevel CRMs.
requirements: 3+ years of B2B lead generation experience managing campaigns across LinkedIn Ads and Google Search.
Proficiency with CRM automation platforms (HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Zapier, Make).
Strong copywriting skills for B2B cold email outreach, ad copy, and landing page offers.
Proven track record of lowering Cost Per Lead (CPL) while increasing qualified call velocity.
niceToHave: Experience with LinkedIn Sales Navigator and data enrichment tools (Apollo, Clay).
Basic knowledge of Webflow or Unbounce landing page design.
